test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

That which cannot be satisfied
solution:
The correct answer is: **Insatiable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Insatiable"** means something that cannot be satisfied, no matter how much is provided. (अतृप्त)

 
 
• **Example:** His **insatiable **appetite for knowledge led him to read thousands of books.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stubborn** (जिद्दी): Someone who refuses to change their opinion or course of action.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite the evidence, he remained **stubborn **and refused to admit his mistake.
 
 
 
• **Drastic** (कट्टर): Something that is extreme and likely to have a significant impact.
 
 
• **Example:** The government introduced **drastic **measures to combat the economic crisis.
 
 
 
• **Prickly** (कंटील): Something that has many sharp points or someone who is easily offended.
 
 
• **Example:** The **prickly **nature of the rose bush made it difficult to handle.
